Now I have the full picture. Here's my comprehensive report:

---

## 🔍 ZYRAXON Source Code — Complete Exploration Report

### 📍 Main Project Directory
```
C:\Users\MMP\Downloads\ZYRAXON-AI-main\ZYRAXON-AI-main
```

This is a **monorepo** (Bun + Turborepo) with 45+ packages under `packages/`.

---

### 🏗️ Architecture Overview

ZYRAXON has **two completely separate systems** for extending functionality:

#### 1. **Built-in LLM Providers** (NOT extensions — hardcoded in the app)
These are native AI provider integrations compiled into the app:
- `packages/llm/src/providers/openai.ts` — ChatGPT (OpenAI)
- `packages/llm/src/providers/openrouter.ts` — OpenRouter
- `packages/llm/src/providers/anthropic.ts` — Claude
- `packages/llm/src/providers/google.ts` — Gemini
- `packages/llm/src/providers/azure.ts` — Azure OpenAI
- `packages/llm/src/providers/amazon-bedrock.ts` — AWS Bedrock
- `packages/llm/src/providers/github-copilot.ts` — GitHub Copilot
- `packages/llm/src/providers/xai.ts` — xAI (Grok)
- `packages/llm/src/providers/cloudflare.ts` — Cloudflare Workers AI
- `packages/llm/src/providers/openai-compatible.ts` — Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint

**Key insight**: "ChatGPT AI" and "OpenRouter AI" are **built-in provider adapters**, NOT installable extensions. They use OpenAI-compatible chat protocols (`packages/llm/src/protocols/openai-chat.ts`).

#### 2. **VS Code Extension System** (installable extensions)
This is the actual extension loading system — downloads VSIX packages and activates them:

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `packages/desktop/src/main/extension-manager.ts` | **Core** — Downloads VSIX, extracts, manages installed extensions |
| `packages/desktop/src/main/extension-host-ipc.ts` | **IPC Bridge** — Connects Electron main process to extension host |
| `packages/app/src/pages/layout/extension-panel.tsx` | **UI** — Extension panel with install/enable/disable/uninstall |
| `packages/desktop/vscode-host/` | **VS Code API Shim** — Provides VS Code API for extensions |

**Extension loading flow:**
1. `extension-manager.ts` downloads VSIX from URL → extracts to `userData/extensions/`
2. `extension-host-ipc.ts` scans `userData/extensions/` → reads `package.json` → builds extension map
3. When activated: imports extension's `main` entry → calls `activate(vscodeAPI)` with VS Code API shim
4. VS Code API shim created in `getVSCodeAPI()` — tries bootstrap.js → vscode-api-shim.js → minimal stub

#### 3. **ZYRAXON Plugin System** (native plugins, different from VS Code extensions)
A separate, Effect-based plugin architecture:

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `packages/plugin/src/v2/promise/plugin.ts` | Plugin definition interface |
| `packages/plugin/src/v2/promise/integration.ts` | Integration hooks for credential/connection management |
| `packages/plugin/src/v2/promise/registration.ts` | Plugin registration system |
| `packages/plugin/src/v2/promise/command.ts` | Command registration |
| `packages/plugin/src/v2/promise/agent.ts` | Agent registration |
| `packages/plugin/src/v2/promise/skill.ts` | Skill registration |

#### 4. **Marketplace/Ecosystem** (discovery + publishing)

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `packages/core/src/tool/marketplace.ts` | **AI Marketplace Tool** — Search 7 marketplaces (ZYRAXON, VSCode, OpenVSX, npm, GitHub Actions, Docker, Chromium) |
| `packages/ecosystem/src/services/marketplace-auto-install.ts` | Auto-install service for marketplace items |
| `packages/ecosystem/src/EcosystemPage.tsx` | Full ecosystem UI page |
| `packages/app/src/pages/session/ecosystem-panel.tsx` | In-session ecosystem panel |
| `marketplace/published/index.json` | Published marketplace items catalog |
| `packages/core/src/tool/marketplace-config.json` | Config (repo + token for publishing) |

---

### 📁 Key Directories

```
ZYRAXON-AI-main/
├── packages/
│   ├── desktop/           # Electron app (main process)
│   │   └── src/main/
│   │       ├── extension-manager.ts      ← VSIX install/uninstall
│   │       ├── extension-host-ipc.ts     ← Extension activation + VS Code API
│   │       └── ipc.ts                    ← Main IPC handlers
│   ├── app/               # SolidJS UI (renderer)
│   │   └── src/pages/
│   │       ├── layout/extension-panel.tsx ← Extension management UI
│   │       ├── session/ecosystem-panel.tsx
│   │       └── ecosystem.tsx
│   ├── llm/               # LLM provider adapters
│   │   └── src/providers/
│   │       ├── openai.ts, openrouter.ts, anthropic.ts, etc.
│   ├── plugin/            # Native plugin SDK
│   │   └── src/v2/promise/
│   │       ├── plugin.ts, integration.ts, command.ts
│   ├── ecosystem/         # Marketplace ecosystem
│   │   └── src/services/
│   │       └── marketplace-auto-install.ts
│   ├── core/              # Core tools
│   │   └── src/tool/
│   │       ├── marketplace.ts            ← 7-marketplace search tool
│   │       └── marketplace-config.json
│   └── ...40+ more packages
├── marketplace/
│   └── published/
│       └── index.json     ← Published items catalog
└── package.json           ← Monorepo root
```

---

### 🔑 Summary

- **"ChatGPT AI" / "OpenRouter AI"** = Built-in LLM provider adapters in `packages/llm/src/providers/`, NOT extensions
- **VS Code extensions** (like marketplace items) = Downloaded as VSIX → managed by `extension-manager.ts` → activated by `extension-host-ipc.ts` with VS Code API shim
- **Native plugins** = Effect-based plugin system in `packages/plugin/`
- **Marketplace** = `packages/core/src/tool/marketplace.ts` searches 7 sources; `marketplace/published/index.json` is the catalog
